scenario: Open the unified field and select Type part.
Wait only for its active criterion token, without waiting for the preceding popover surface to detach.
Immediately click the field again, then Clear all.
baseline.observed: Clear all briefly resolves as an enabled button, becomes unstable, then detaches when the popover closes. Chromium click times out.
baseline.control: The corresponding scenario passes when the preceding popover has detached before reopening.
baseline.acceptance: Incomplete Browser filtering/lifecycle behavior. A further pinned-popover lifecycle correction and passing immediate-reopen test are required. This remains #80.

rootCause: Previous asynchronous floating-portal cleanup unregistered reused portal identity while the new field still reported aria-expanded=true.
correction: Distinct popover/context/portal identity per opening, generation-bound callbacks, stable enabled input, correct trigger DOM identity for outside-click exclusion.
